sourceDeclaration: V2.3.4 (12-18-2022), community decompilation mirror; not authenticated against licensed PC binary

initialization.population: shared HashMap entry order, then red HashMap entry order; locked IDs filtered before shuffle
initialization.shuffle: five Collections.shuffle calls, each seeded by one relicRng.randomLong; common/uncommon/rare/shop/boss order
initialization.removal: relicsToRemoveOnStart removed after all five shuffles; no re-shuffle or random re-pick
initialization.saveRestore: saved five queues restored, not reconstructed from supported/remaining IDs

drawing.front: normal, elite, chest, Neow, boss and wrappers
drawing.tail: shop, except boss always uses front
drawing.failedCanSpawn: candidate permanently removed; continue same tier from tail even if first request was front

emptyFallback.boss: Red Circlet requested / Circlet resolved by missing-library fallback

drawing.ownership: single shared queues spent at OFFER creation; not only when claimed; no per-channel replenishment
drawing.randomSelection: no RNG call per ordinary queue draw; rarity RNG belongs to the source channel

elite.rng: one relicRng.random(0,99) per ordinary relic; 50 common / 33 uncommon / 17 rare

chest.rng: treasureRng chooses chest type 50/33/17, then ONE 0..99 roll shared by gold eligibility and relic tier; optional gold float jitter

boss-chest.rng: no rarity roll; create 3 front boss offers, all 3 spent before choice

shop-normal.rng: first two slots each merchantRng.random(99), 48 common / 34 uncommon / 18 rare; each item has separate non-daily price float jitter

shop-exclusive.rng: third initial slot forced SHOP, no rarity roll; separate price jitter

courier-restock.rng: new ordinary rarity roll for every retry, INCLUDING restock of initial SHOP slot; price jitter after valid relic

neow-swap.rng: lose starter before forced boss draw; Black Blood canSpawn then fails and is consumed if encountered

neow-lament.rng: direct NeowsBlessing, not any tier queue

random-event-screenless.rng: one relicRng rarity roll 50/33/17; screenless wrapper repeatedly draws SAME tier and spends Bottled Flame/Lightning/Tornado and Whetstone

dead-adventurer-fight.rng: remaining RELIC reward uses general 50/33/17 rarity and ordinary draw, not screenless wrapper

black-star-extra.rng: additional elite rarity roll 50/33/17; non-campfire wrapper spends Girya/Peace Pipe/Shovel and retries SAME tier

calling-bell.rng: one common, one uncommon, one rare using screenless wrapper; no rarity rolls

matryoshka.rng: one relicRng.randomBoolean(0.75) -> common else uncommon; before ordinary non-boss chest relic

golden-idol.rng: direct Golden Idol; duplicate becomes Circlet; not a queue

mushrooms-fight.rng: fight choice direct Odd Mushroom reward; duplicate becomes Circlet

accursed-blacksmith.rng: Rummage gives WarpedTongs and Pain; not a tier draw

bonfire-curse.rng: offer curse for Spirit Poop; duplicate becomes Circlet

face-trader.rng: miscRng.randomLong seeds shuffle of unowned faces in CultistMask/FaceOfCleric/GremlinMask/NlothsMask/SsserpentHead order; first face; all owned -> Circlet

ironclad-start.rng: direct Burning Blood, outside tier queues

relics.dependencyNote: Subtracts two card reward options via ordered hook; energy boss relic may enter Act1 through Neow swap.
Obtains Curse of the Bell then creates common/uncommon/rare screenless rewards, spending all offers and rejected candidates; recursive pending-reward flow required.

relics.implementationLimitation: Outside-combat permanent curse obtain +6 maxHP via canonical Run.increaseMaxHp; active or retained combat/pending-reward health contexts reject atomically. Full source acquisition, natural play and platform evidence remain pending. See tests/fixtures/darkstone-periapt-source-contract.json.

relics.dependencyNote: canSpawn act <=1; may be Neow swap or Act1 boss offer. Gold prohibition must cover every route and stolen-gold behavior.
Adds Lift campfire option, maximum three lifts; accumulated strength at battle start. Shares two-campfire-relic spawn cap with Peace Pipe/Shovel.

relics.implementationLimitation: Actual event obtain/trap choices, rounded non-chest GOLD offer bonus and same-owner Moai sacrifice are locally wired. SPECIAL remains event-only and outside ordinary treasure/shop queues; complete natural event/campaign, dedicated art and PC/platform/live acceptance remain pending.

relics.projectPartialHookNote: The data entry, ordinary acquisition adapter and unknown-room ownership hook are integrated. Full source relic-queue acquisition and per-item platform/live acceptance remain pending.

relics.implementationLimitation: Named SPECIAL obtain and shared player healing gate component-covered. Ordinary queues, source registration and later-act scope unchanged; MindBloom/parent Run/Nodes integration, natural campaign and native evidence pending.

relics.dependencyNote: Next two non-boss chests add a relic before ordinary chest draw; 75% common else uncommon via relicRng; normal canSpawn applies.
NeowsLament class: three battles set each starting monster HP to one; special Neow choice, not common/rare/boss queue.
After ordinary chest rewards exist, removes one relic reward; spent queue entries remain spent. Does not affect boss chest.
Adds one-card removal campfire option; bottled/removal eligibility and confirmation required; shares campfire relic spawn cap.
CombatRewardScreen adds second card reward only to ordinary MonsterRoom, excluding elite and boss; source relic class has no gameplay hook override.

Card rewards use every unlocked eligible color at rolled rarity, including colorless; grant one orb slot to non-Defect with zero slots. Requires other classes card/power/orb/stance/discard mechanics. Does NOT add other-color relic libraries.
Adds one card to reward options through ordered changeNumberOfCardsInReward hook, including colorless reward generation.

relics.excludedReason: Act2 Masked Bandits / Act3 Red Mask Tomb
relics.implementationLimitation: Actual Tomb event obtain and opening BOT Weak1 are locally wired. Source SPECIAL and later-act scope unchanged; Masked Bandits, full natural campaign, dedicated art and PC/platform/live acceptance pending.

relics.dependencyNote: Adds Dig campfire action and normal shared-queue reward with 50/33/17 rarity; shares campfire relic spawn cap.
Card reward screen provides alternative +2 max HP; source relic class alone does not implement the choice. Must resolve only the chosen reward item.
Energy plus potion acquisition prohibition; claim consumes blocked potion offer per current original-list protocol, not a permanently pending reward.

relics.implementationLimitation: Obtain and display are wired. scoreAdjustment returns -1, but no production total-score calculation consumes it; source total-score deduction remains unintegrated.

relics.projectPartialHookNote: The data entry, ordinary acquisition adapter and persisted every-fourth-question counter are integrated in the actual Nodes entry. Full source relic-queue acquisition and per-item platform/live acceptance remain pending.

relics.implementationLimitation: Skill acquisition and source-specific preview/equip hooks, max-floor48 and local channels are implemented. Existing restricted shop/treasure distribution, complete natural campaign and PC/platform/live acceptance remain pending.

Shared onLoseHpLast is wired in battle/event HP paths with actual treasure/shop and source Rare-head component evidence. Complete source acquisition wrappers, whole campaign and platform/live acceptance remain pending.

relics.dependencyNote: WingBoots class / display Wing Boots: three persisted charges; next-row non-edge traversal checked by MapRoomNode; decrement only on winged move, not normal edge.
Requires Burning Blood at draw time; Neow swap removes starter first, so cannot offer Black Blood then. After Act1 boss replacement permitted if starter retained.

fallbacks.reason: rare queue exhausted / duplicate event special / all faces owned
fallbacks.implementationLimitation: Resolved Circlet is obtainable from repeated Bonfire curse offerings; repeats increment the existing counter without a second relic slot. Finite source queue exhaustion resolves it locally; treasure/shop do not yet consume the shared full queue. Red Circlet remains an unresolved source alias, not a separately implemented relic.

fallbacks.reason: boss queue exhausted; mirror getRelic does not register Red Circlet and falls back to Circlet
fallbacks.implementationLimitation: Resolved Circlet is obtainable from repeated Bonfire curse offerings; repeats increment the existing counter without a second relic slot. Finite source queue exhaustion resolves it locally; treasure/shop do not yet consume the shared full queue. Red Circlet remains an unresolved source alias, not a separately implemented relic.

classLocalEffectsBoundary: Supplemental current local-effect bindings for the chosen Silent/Defect/Watcher class only; not additions to this IRONCLAD profile registrationOrder, 149 original records, 130 queue slots or its 89/95 missing sets. Full source catalogs/queues, all remaining unavailable content and natural/platform evidence boundaries are unchanged.

classLocalEffects.implementationLimitation: Poison ApplyPower construction captures player-source bonus before Artifact; no raw-status/decay bonus. Actual common class queue shop/chest/elite hooks are locally covered; complete natural campaign and PC/platform/live acceptance remain pending.
